Name: Ghostscape
Description: A spooky point-and-click escape game: explore a haunted house, photograph the paranormal activity, collect occult items and diary pages, and solve its puzzles to uncover the house's dark secrets.

Achievements.Name: First Contact
Achievements.Description: This achievement is awarded the first time you take a photograph of any paranormal activity.

Achievements.Name: Exorcist
Achievements.Description: This achievement is awarded when ALL the paranormal activity in the house have been photographed.

Achievements.Name: Occult Investigator
Achievements.Description: Collect ALL the occult items that are around the house.

Achievements.Name: Diary Demon
Achievements.Description: Collect all the pages of the diary.

Achievements.Name: The Medium
Achievements.Description: Photograph all the ghostly messages around the house.

Achievements.Name: Explorer
Achievements.Description: Investigate all the rooms in the house, even the secret ones...

Achievements.Name: Art Collector
Achievements.Description: Photograph all the strange pictures in the house.

Achievements.Name: Cypher Master
Achievements.Description: Decode all the cases you find in the house.

Achievements.Name: Bone Collector
Achievements.Description: Photograph all the corpses you come across in the house.
